title.narrative: Institutional strengthening Interamerican court of human rights
Institutionellt stärkande Interamerikanska domstolen för mänskliga rättigheter

description.narrative:
The objective of the intervention is to contribute to the institutional strengthening of the Inter American Court of Human Rights in order to improve the human rights situation in the States Parties to the American Convention of Human Rights.
The objective will be achieve through 4 main outcomes:
1. Strengthen the jurisdictional activity of the Inter-American Court by supporting the holding of sessions and the conduct of judicial proceedings in the States.
2. Strengthen the resources and computer security of the Inter-American Court and its Library.
3. Strengthen the human rights training capacities of the Inter-American Court.
4. Strengthen the dissemination of the work and jurisprudence of the Inter-American Court through the translation of key decisions.

Insatsen löper över tre år, 2023-2025, med ett totalt belopp på 24 000 000 kr, och omfattar:
1) Stöd till domstolens rättegångsarbete under sessionsperioderna, samt till rättsliga förfaranden på plats i medlemsländerna.
2) Förstärkning av informationshanteringen, inklusive informationssäkerhet, samt stöd till domstolens virtuella bibliotek.
3) Förstärkning av domstolens kursverksamhet
4) Stöd till arbetet med att informera om domstolens rättspraxis, inklusive översättning av domar till engelska och portugisiska.

The support covers three years, 2023-2025, with a total amount of SEK 24 000 000, and aims at continuing the lines of work previously supported by Sweden, including:
1) Strengthening of the jurisdictional work of the Court by supporting the periods of sessions and carrying out legal proceedings in the member states.
2) Strengthening of information management including security of information and the resources of the Court and its library.
3) Strengthening of the training capacities of the Court.
4) Strengthening the work with dissemination of Court jurisprudence, including translation of key decisions.

title.narrative: Agreement Inter American Court for Human Rights
Agreement, Inter American Court of Human Rights 2023 - 2025
Decision Inter American Court for Human Rights

description.narrative:
Achievements of outcome 1: Strengthen Jurisdictional Activity.
During this first year, the Inter-American Court of Human Rights managed to carry out nine regular sessions and one extraordinary period, which meant 22 weeks of collegiate work. During the sessions, the Inter-American Court carried out, among others, the following activities:
It held public and private audiences on contentious cases, advisory opinions, cases in the compliance monitoring stage, and interim measures. It deliberated and delivered judgement in contentious cases and advisory opinions, issued resolutions on compliance supervision and provisional measures. Supervised the enforcement of judgments and the implementation of provisional measures. It considered various steps in the cases pending before the Court, as well as administrative issues, and It carried out dissemination and training activities and held meetings with national and international authorities.
Achievements of outcome 2: Strengthen the resources and computer security.
Every year, the Technology Department of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights carries out an analysis of the tools and platforms in operation, and evaluate the technical service provided, and has expressed its satisfaction.
3) Office 365 licensing renewal
For the Inter-American Court of Human Rights, it has been essential to renew Microsoft 365, as it is one of the greatest advances in the field of collaborative work, it has made it easier to have information at any time and place, it has made it possible to develop projects with flows designed to suit the use of the different areas and for staff to collaborate in real time through tools such as Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Forms, Microsoft Planner, etc.
Achievements of outcome 3: Information and knowledge management
In 2023, work was done on the development of resources for the search for jurisprudence, on the renewal and acquisition of bibliographic resources, both digital and physical, and on the improvement of accessibility for people with disabilities. Acquisition and/or Renewal of Database and Digital Bibliographic Materials.
Achievements of outcome 4: Translation of key decisions
Work was done to standardize translation criteria by updating the Translation Manual, which had not been updated in nearly 10 years. At the end of 2023, a review of the Manual was carried out and a new update is available, which is conceptualized as an element that must be reviewed periodically to improve and adapt to the needs of the Court.
As for the decisions translated in 2023, they refer to various key issues for the protection of human rights in the region, such as the rights of indigenous peoples, the forced disappearance of persons, extrajudicial executions, the disproportionate use of force, human rights defenders, economic and social rights, cultural and environmental rights, rights of children and adolescents, rights of people with disabilities, the rights of people deprived of liberty, among many others.
In general terms, the annual report reflects a satisfactory achievement of results during the first year of implementation, despite the fact that the project had some delays at the beginning.
